profile.headline: Principle Member Technical Staff at AT&T
profile.summary:
Curtis is a graduate of The University of Colorado at Boulder with a degree in Computer Science. He also maintains a post-graduate Master's degree in the field of Computer Science with an emphasis on mobile programming development from the Naval Postgraduate School.

From 1993 untill the end of 1994, Curtis began his military journey enlisted in the United States Navy at NTC/RTC San Diego.  He obtained an Reserved Officer Training Corps scholarship and attended Colorado University.  Upon graduation, Curtis was commisioned an officer in the United States Marine Corps.  While on duty, Captain Smith maintained titles of Division Officer for MALS-14 Aviation Life Support Systems, Assitant Aircraft Maintenance Officer for VMA-542, and Aicraft Maintenance Officer for 2d Marine Aircraft Wing deployed.  

After his Master's degree with emphasis on Mobile and Wireless Technologies, Captain Smith pursued  increasing software development responsibilities in the private sector.

In 2007 Cutis began his private sector career at Terrago Technologies as a software engineer.

Specialties: Software design C++, C#, Java, TypeScript, ODBC, SQLplus; Personell Management; Network principles; Aquisitions, ISSA Certification, Agile Development, UML design

positions.title: Senior Software Programmer
positions.description: Integrating and designing from scratch client/server solutions on mobile, desktop and embedded systems in Java, C# and embedded C.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Liaison is a company that deals with data integration across many technologies.  nuBridges was acquired by Liaion in April 2011.  As a Software Engineer at Liaison, I have continued supporting socket applications and also developed new integration of the HL7 standard for reading edi documents into the core dll library and across the end user interface.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing and maintaining electonic business software solutions that deal with encryption and internet traffic. 
Codes in a multiplatform envirionment from Linux, HPUX, Solaris, AIX to Windows.  
Manipulate databases from ODBC sources, SQLPlus and database scripts.
Extensive use of C++ makefiles and C# Windows Presentation Framework.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development project lead for Terrago Mobile.  Position requires interaction with the Program and Project Mangers.  Ensure team tasks are assigned and follow through with progress of all software design and code for each task.  Schedule meetings with stakeholders ranging from product schudeling to code reviews.

Developed C++ code with the Agile development process.  This development process sought code deliverables after each iteration process.  Worked with updating static library code and developing application code in a mobile envirionment.  Involves ensuring Wn32 library code is portable to mobile SDK.

positions.title: Captain
Network Operator  Intern
positions.description:
Managed Virtual Local Area Networks on 130 Foundry 4802 switches.
Manage AirMagnet: Wireless Security Sensor Grid.
Maintain and upgrade 19/21 AirMagnet hardware sensors.
Administrate the Tripwire server file verification suite on all network servers.
